role: RR-interval artifact detector: classifies every beat against a rolling median of its neighbourhood as technical (out of range), extra, missed, ectopic or clean, and computes the artifact percentage of a window; also declares the sorted-[Double] binary-search helpers shared with WindowSelector.
types: ArtifactDetector.Config: struct — windowSize (HRVConstants.Artifacts.windowSize = 50), ectopic 0.20, missed 0.50, extra 0.30, minRR/maxRR
Array where Element == Double: extension — sortedInsertionIndex/sortedFirstIndex binary searches
toplevel: Config default values: ectopicThreshold 0.20, missedThreshold 0.50, extraThreshold 0.30, windowSize/minRR/maxRR from HRVConstants. The rolling median is computed over ALL raw values including out-of-range (technical) beats, so a burst of technical artifacts shifts the median used to judge neighbouring beats.

flags.text: computeRollingMedian is fed every raw rr_ms including beats that classify() then rejects as technical (outside minRR..maxRR), so dropouts/zeros or huge values bias the reference median for nearby valid beats.

units.does: Returns one ArtifactFlags per RR point: computes the rolling median of rr_ms over config.windowSize and classifies each beat against its median.

Classifies one beat: out of [minRR,maxRR] → technical artifact (confidence 1); shorter than 0.7×median → shortBeatFlags; longer than 1.2×median → longBeatFlags; deviation ratio > 0.20 → ectopic; else clean.

branches.effect: return technical artifact, confidence 1.0; else continue

branches.cond: ratio > ectopicThreshold (only reachable for rr in [0.7m,0.8m))
branches.effect: ectopic artifact with confidence min(1, ratio/0.2); else .clean

flags.text: With the default Config every artifact gets confidence 1.0: each branch divides a ratio already above its threshold by that threshold (generic 0.2-0.3 ratio / 0.2, short >0.3 / 0.3, long-ectopic >0.2 / 0.2, missed >0.5 / 0.5) and clamps to 1.0, so ArtifactFlags.confidence carries no information; no production code reads it.

docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's table says a short beat is ectopic only below median x 0.7 (outer gate) with deviation > 20%; the code also flags beats between 0.7 and 0.8 x median as ectopic through the generic `ratio > ectopicThreshold` branch.

units.does: Short beat: below 50% of median → extra-beat artifact; otherwise ectopic, flagged as artifact when ratio > ectopicThreshold; confidence min(1, ratio/extraThreshold).

branches.effect: return .extra artifact; else .ectopic with isArtifact = ratio > 0.20

flags.text: shortBeatFlags is only reached when rr < 0.7×median, i.e. ratio > 0.30, so with the default config `isArtifact: ratio > config.ectopicThreshold` (0.20) is always true; the non-artifact outcome is unreachable unless a custom Config sets extraThreshold < ectopicThreshold.

units.does: Long beat (>120% of median): above (1+missedThreshold)×median → missed-beat artifact (confidence ratio/0.5); otherwise ectopic artifact (confidence ratio/0.2).
Percentage (0-100) of flags marked isArtifact in the clamped half-open window [start,end).

flags.text: ImportDataView.assembleResult recomputes the window artifact percentage inline instead of calling artifactPercentage, without the index clamping or the empty-window guard (divides by windowEnd - windowStart).

units.does: Rolling median per index using an insertion-sorted window centred on i (halfWindow = windowSize/2 each side, truncated at edges).

branches.cond: bootstrap loop over the first min(count, halfWindow+1) values
branches.effect: each inserted into sorted at its binary-search index
slide window and append median; if count == 1 the range 1..<1 is empty and only the bootstrap median is returned

flags.text: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md says a 'centered 50-beat sliding window'; with windowSize 50, halfWindow = 25 on each side plus the beat itself gives a 51-beat window (and the median includes the beat being judged).

units.does: Slides the sorted window to position i: inserts values[i+halfWindow] when in range, removes one copy of values[i-halfWindow-1] when it exists.

branches.effect: insert the entering value; else nothing enters (right edge)

branches.cond: oldLeft >= 0 and the value is found in sorted
branches.effect: remove it; else nothing removed (left edge, or not found — which cannot happen since every leaving value was inserted earlier)

flags.text: WindowSelector.slideWindow is a line-for-line copy of this function (same signature and body); only the shared sortedInsertionIndex/sortedFirstIndex helpers were factored out.

units.does: Median of a sorted array: mean of the two middle elements for even count, middle element for odd.

branches.effect: average of sorted[mid-1] and sorted[mid] (for empty input this would index -1 and crash, but callers never pass empty); else sorted[mid]

units.does: Binary search: lower-bound index at which value inserts keeping the ascending array sorted.

branches.effect: keep halving; exits with lo = first index whose element >= value

units.does: Index of the first element exactly equal to value, nil when absent (uses sortedInsertionIndex).

branches.cond: lo out of bounds or element != value
